simple.meaning: גִּבְעֹל (gibʻôl) is a Hebrew word meaning “the calyx of a flower.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H1392. gibol גִּבְעֹל noun [masculine] bud (Ol § 216 b ) — Exod 9:31 the flax was bud (i.e. in bud Dr § 188 , (2)), compare RS JPh xii.299, 300 .

occurrences.englishText: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.
